answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 11 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in trellis, queued in summit, and sonnet publishes the wait time. A farm of 123 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1397 identities would post 3068 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
